title: Accept shadow detector observation dry-run payloads
user_business_goal: Let MLOps/engineering validate review-only detector observation metadata against the current shadow model manifest from the artifact intake bundle, without running inference, reading raw media, or granting production authority.
out_of_scope: raw images, videos, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
request-supplied filesystem paths, model manifests, model refs as authority, dataset paths, or artifact directories
HMI visual redesign or QC tablet layout changes
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Add a metadata-only shadow detector dry-run path to the app.
The app accepts a request payload containing detector request metadata and sanitized observation metadata.
The app reads the model manifest only from FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR; it must not accept request-supplied manifest, model, dataset, or filesystem paths.

When artifact intake is ready and observations are valid, the app returns detector.result.v1 with adapter manifest-detector, decision ASSIST, manifest-filled model_ref/evidence_ref, and production_authority=false.
When no observations are supplied, the app returns NOT_EVALUATED with MODEL_MISSING and production_authority=false.
Invalid labels, invalid bbox/confidence, raw-media source URIs, missing intake, or invalid intake fail closed.
Existing detector status, replay/HMI observation flow, artifact readiness, feedback, and product CI behavior remains valid.

memory_preflight.query: Flange QC v2 shadow detector observation integration, manifest detector adapter, artifact intake readiness, no model execution.
retrieved_decisions: App integrates sanitized metadata through contracts.
Manifest detector adapter is review-only and production authority remains false.
retrieved_lessons: Keep model bridge metadata-only and env-bound.
Request payloads cannot supply filesystem paths, model refs, evidence refs, or authority.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is understood as non-app-code auth/session blocker; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-042 PR to remove the shadow detector observation dry-run path, tests, docs, and gate evidence. Existing detector status endpoint, replay/HMI observation flow, artifact readiness, feedback, and product CI behavior remain valid.
